courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 微影晶圓台精密定位
related.titleEn: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
related.transfer: 可遷移「光程差、條紋與相位細分」與「空氣折射率、Edlén 公式與死程誤差」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；微影晶圓台精密定位的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision" and "Air refractive index, the Edlén equation and dead-path error" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦外差式雷射干涉儀的條紋計數、空氣折射率補償與幾何誤差預算；微影晶圓台精密定位則以掃描同步、Abbe 原理、Lorentz 致動、干涉儀與光柵量測、伺服前饋與套刻預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fringe counting, air-index compensation and geometric error budgets for heterodyne laser interferometers; Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages centres on scan synchronisation, Abbe principle, Lorentz actuation, interferometer and grating metrology, servo feedforward and overlay budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」與「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到微影晶圓台精密定位，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” and “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雷射干涉位移量測
history.text: Michelson 在 1890 年代以干涉儀用鎘紅線定義公尺，奠定以波長作長度單位的思路；1960 年公尺改以 Kr-86 波長定義，同年 HeNe 雷射問世，1970 年代 Hewlett-Packard 推出以 Zeeman 雙頻 HeNe 為核心的商用外差式干涉儀，使機台校正與晶圓台定位得以追溯到波長。1983 年公尺改由光速定義後，碘穩頻 HeNe 的 632.99 nm 成為 CIPM 建議的實現方式，Edlén 公式及其修正版與 Ciddor 公式則提供空氣折射率的公開計算基礎，今日 NIST 仍以線上工具箱公開提供。本課只重建公開原理，不涉及任何廠商的專有訊號處理。
history.textEn: Michelson used an interferometer in the 1890s to express the metre in cadmium red-line wavelengths, establishing the wavelength as a unit of length; in 1960 the metre was redefined by the Kr-86 wavelength, the same year the HeNe laser appeared, and in the 1970s Hewlett-Packard introduced commercial heterodyne interferometers built on Zeeman two-frequency HeNe lasers, making machine calibration and wafer-stage positioning traceable to the wavelength. After the 1983 speed-of-light definition of the metre, the iodine-stabilised HeNe at 632.99 nm became a CIPM-recommended realisation, while the Edlén equation with its revisions and the Ciddor equation gave a public basis for air-index computation, still offered online by NIST today. This course reconstructs public principles only, not any vendor's proprietary signal processing.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「光程差、條紋與相位細分」到「溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision" through "Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
